question: Which of the following rivers joins the Ganga at Sonpur near Patna?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gandak**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gandak** River joins the **Ganga** at **Sonpur** **near Patna**.
 
• Gandak river of **Bihar** flows through West **Champaran, Gopalganj, Saran, **and** Muzaffarpur district. **
 
• It is formed by the union of **Kali** and **Trisuli** rivers from where up to the Indian boundary , the river is called as **Narayani River**.
 
• It is one of the major rivers of** Nepal**.
 
• It originates from **Nhubine Himal Glacier**.
 
• The **Burhi Gandak** flows parallel to and east of the Gandak river in an old channel.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ganga** is the** longest river **of India.

 
 
• length - **2510 km.**
 
 
 
• **Basin **area - **1.32 million sq. km**.
 
 
• Origin - **Gangotri Glacier, Gangotri Glacier, Nanda Devi, Satopanth Glacier, Kedarnath, Nanda Kot, Trisul, Kamet.**
